drafts.draft_en: I asked AI for the reverse angle of my own shot. Same actor, same pose, same light. One frame became a full coverage sequence. This is how I'd shoot a VFX scene on zero budget now. Breakdown below 👇
drafts.video_tip: 12s: your original wide shot, hard cut to the AI reverse angle, then a 4-shot coverage montage (OTS, close-up, insert, wide). On-screen label 'from 1 frame' for the first 2s. Prompt in reply 1.

drafts.draft_en: Halloween night VFX, one prompt: a ghost walking through the Old Port fog, practical-effects look, 1970s film stock. The prompt is below, swap the city for yours and post it 🎃
drafts.video_tip: 10-12s, grainy 70s look, slow push-in on a misty harbour, ghost passes through a boat mast, flickering street lamp. End on a title card 'MARSEILLE, 31.10'. Bracketed prompt in the first reply.

drafts.draft_en: Saturday Challenge 🎬 Pick a song, pick a decade, make the music video that never existed. Mine: Bohemian Rhapsody (1931). Post yours below, best one gets featured next week.
drafts.video_tip: 12-15s, 1.33:1 black and white, 1930s opera house, heavy grain and flicker, 3 cuts on the beat, end card 'BOHEMIAN RHAPSODY (1931)'. Pin the rules in reply 1.

drafts.draft_en:
Prompt share: cinematic VFX hero shot 🎬

[Character] standing in [location] as [VFX event] happens behind them, [lens]mm anamorphic, [time of day] light, practical debris and smoke, slow dolly-in, film grain. Swap the brackets and show me yours.
drafts.video_tip: 4-image grid of the same template (tidal wave, collapsing tower, portal, meteor), then a 5s animated version of the best one in Kling or Seedance.

drafts.draft_en: I didn't touch a timeline for this one. I described the shot to an AI agent, asked for 3 changes, and it built the VFX pass. The speed is wild, but taste is still the job. Before/after below.
drafts.video_tip: Split screen: left your typed instructions appearing one by one, right the shot updating after each change. 10s, then a wipe from raw plate to final composite.
